articles.title: Bitcoin near $60,000 today vs February: Institutional sentiment has flipped

articles.title: Abra’s Bill Barhydt says Wall Street’s next crypto bet is tokenization

articles.title: Ethereum Foundation cuts and departures aren't a crisis, Joe Lubin says
articles.snippet: The Consensys leader told CoinDesk the Ethereum Foundation's role should be narrower and more focused on stewarding the network's core technology and values.
